name: Zarathustra Xanthus
summary: A powerful human warrior who is one with peformance, dice, and fists. He has mastered the art of the 'black flip', and has no fears... instead, he is the one to be feared.

name: Zyvan Woodfoot
summary: A motivational wood elf leader who is always the first to rally his troops towards greatness. He focuses on his unquenchable thirst for the destruction of all dragons across Elandria. He seeks to save the land by leading his soldiers through both diplomatic and military endeavors, saving the world one dragon at a time.

name: Zeldris Remir
summary: A mastermind tiefling strategist with love for the arcane. He has strong ambitions to become the strongest with magic in all of Elandria, and seeks to preserve his knowledge for any amount of time to come.

name: Björn Asulf
summary: An eruptive dwarven combat engineer with a love for war machinery and explosive devices. He built his own tank and unfortunately lost it in combat. He seeks to one day rebuild a new and stronger tank.

name: Finnegan Fairweather
summary: A reliable wood elf guitarist with a sidekick dragon named Princess Steve. He found revenge against Malachi for his parents, and seeks to protect the Citadel of Dragon Slaying and Shenanigans against further harm.

name: Ælendor Gälendir
summary: A steadfast eladrin druid who will protect his allies at all costs. He saved his party against an alukah invasion in Valeria, but in doing so he contracted their curse and was converted into one of those monstrosities...

name: Bit Chass
summary: A mysterious astral elf who aided in the effort of uncovering the truth about Malachi. He met the Shadow Merchant Money Gang early before they established their name, but then decided to go his seperate way. The existince of Bit Chass is now a mystery.

name: Ic
summary: An airborne aarakocra arcane user who flew in to help the Shadow Merchant Money Gang while Finnegan Fairweather took a short break at the Citadel of Dragon Slaying and Shenanigans. It is forgotten why he decided to come help, but while he did he provided expert close air support to all combats for a short period of time. After this he flew back away, just before Finn had returned.
